mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is active whenever GDP growth is positive, regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% signals labor market deterioration and reduced consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with UNRATE > 6.5, or the Rank IC for the threshold is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in labor market activity (PAYEMS) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through increased corporate revenue visibility.
failure_condition: The joint growth of PAYEMS and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) compresses real corporate profits and increases discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with FEDFUNDS > 0.5 and CPIAUCSL > 2.5, or the Rank IC for the regime signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) indicates rising price pressures that erode real corporate margins and increase the risk of monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with rising CPIAUCSL, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 900 thousand units signals reduced construction activity and weak consumer confidence, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with HOUST < 900, or the Rank IC for the threshold signal is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of weak industrial production (INDPRO year-over-year growth rate < 0.5%), manufacturing slowdowns reduce corporate earnings visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with INDPRO growth < 0.5%, or the Rank IC for the trigger is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.5%) signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate hiring, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with UNRATE < 5.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
